claim: 14 Rab proteins (Rab3A/B/C/D, Rab5A/B/C, Rab8A/B, Rab10, Rab12, Rab29, Rab35 and Rab43) are specifically phosphorylated by LRRK2.

evidence: This claim is supported by the systematic analysis described in the manuscript, which includes experimental data from overexpression and mass spectrometry experiments.
